name: Create or Destroy Water

components.m: a mix of water and sand

targets.description: an open container, or a 30-foot Cube

upcast.text: Per slot level above 1: 10 more gallons, or the Cube grows by 5 feet.

summary: Create or destroy up to 10 gallons of water, or make rain or clear fog in a 30-foot Cube.
text: Choose one effect. Create Water: up to 10 gallons of clean water appear in an open container within range, or the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range and puts out exposed flames there. Destroy Water: up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range vanish, or fog in a 30-foot Cube within range is cleared away. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: for each slot level above 1, you create or destroy 10 more gallons, or the Cube grows by 5 feet.
